IC4: - Full-mouth plaque score (FMPS) [AND] and full-mouth bleeding score (FMBS) ≤ 10% (measured at four sites per tooth).

IC7: - [NOT] No history of mucogingival [OR] or periodontal surgery at experimental sites.
